sets.context:
Five people - P, Q, R, S and T - live on five floors of a building, numbered 1 (ground) to 5 (top), one person per floor, subject to these conditions:
1. P lives above Q.
2. R lives immediately above S.
3. T does not live on floor 1 or floor 5.
4. Q lives above T.

explanations: Incorrect. Q is on floor 4, one below the top.
Incorrect. R is on floor 2, near the bottom.
Incorrect. T is on floor 3, in the middle.
Correct. The full stack is S(1)-R(2)-T(3)-Q(4)-P(5), so P is on top.

Incorrect. S is on floor 1, the bottommost.
Correct. T is on floor 3, so floor 3 holds T.
Incorrect. Q is on floor 4, above T.
questions.solution: 1. Stack: S(1)-R(2)-T(3)-Q(4)-P(5). 2. Floor 3 holds T, which is option C. Answer C.

Incorrect. T is on floor 3, above R, not below.
Incorrect. Q is on floor 4, two floors above R.

questions.prompt: If P and S interchange their floors (everything else unchanged), who lives on floor 5?
questions.solution: 1. Original: S(1)-R(2)-T(3)-Q(4)-P(5). 2. After swapping P and S: P(1)-R(2)-T(3)-Q(4)-S(5). 3. Floor 5 holds S, which is option B. Answer B.

sets.context:
Five tasks - A, B, C, D and E - are scheduled from Monday to Friday (one per day), subject to these conditions:
1. A is scheduled before B.
2. C is scheduled on Wednesday.
3. D is scheduled immediately after E.
4. B is scheduled before D.

explanations: Incorrect. A is on Monday, the first day.
Incorrect. B is on Tuesday.
Correct. Condition 2 fixes C on Wednesday directly.
Incorrect. D is on Friday, paired after E.
questions.prompt: Which task is scheduled on Wednesday?
questions.solution: 1. Condition 2 directly fixes C on Wednesday. 2. Cross-check: A(Mon)-B(Tue)-C(Wed)-E(Thu)-D(Fri) satisfies all four conditions. 3. Wednesday is C, which is option C. Answer C.

explanations: Incorrect. C is on Wednesday, far from E.
Correct. E is on Thursday and D immediately follows it on Friday.
Incorrect. A is on Monday.
Incorrect. B is on Tuesday.
questions.prompt: Which task is scheduled immediately after E?
questions.solution: 1. Schedule: A(Mon)-B(Tue)-C(Wed)-E(Thu)-D(Fri). 2. Immediately after Thursday is Friday. 3. Friday holds D, which is option B. Answer B.

explanations: Incorrect. E is on Thursday - this statement is true.
Incorrect. D is on Friday - true.
Incorrect. B is on Tuesday - true.
Correct. A is on Monday, so 'A is on Friday' is the false one.
questions.prompt: Which of the following statements must be FALSE?
questions.solution: 1. Full schedule: A-B-C-E-D. 2. E Thursday: true. D Friday: true. B Tuesday: true. 3. A is Monday, so 'A is on Friday' is false - option D. Answer D.

explanations: Incorrect. D moves to Wednesday in the swapped scenario.
Correct. After the swap C moves to Friday (D takes Wednesday).
Incorrect. E stays on Thursday.
Incorrect. A stays on Monday.
questions.prompt: If C and D interchange their days (everything else unchanged), which task is on Friday?
questions.solution: 1. Original: A(Mon)-B(Tue)-C(Wed)-E(Thu)-D(Fri). 2. After swapping C and D: A-B-D-E-C, so Friday holds C. 3. Friday is C, which is option B. Answer B.
